newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S.A.S. Dragon in HK$48.7 mln rights issue.
newsitem.headline: S.A.S. Dragon in HK$48.7 mln rights issue.

text.p: S.A.S. Dragon Holdings Ltd has proposed to raise HK$48.7 million through a rights issue of a total 139.22 million new shares at HK$0.35 per rights share, the company said on Friday.
The rights shares will be distributed in proportion of one new share for every two existing shares held, it said
Net proceeds of about HK$47.1 million will be mainly used to buy a group of companies which engages in trading of sports goods and accessories from independent third parties.
S.A.S. shares fell HK$0.105 or 18.75 percent to HK$0.45 per share in early trade. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
